description: Copy every diary entry from one date onto another, adding to what is already there. This can create many entries at once and cannot be undone as a batch, so it requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirm only after the user directly requested this change.

destination_date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

source_date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

name: copy_day
title: Copy Diary Day
